items.title: Register milestone-closeout.json as an artifact fact in process-fact-registry.ts
items.context: Add a PROCESS_FACT_ARTIFACT_BY_COMMAND ref (name/path milestone-closeout.json, signed:false, producerCommand story_advance DONE-time capture implemented in handlers/milestone-status.ts, written via store.writeMilestoneCloseout at store.ts ~706) plus a PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY fact entry named artifact:milestone-closeout.json modeled on the adjacent artifact:milestone-ledger.json entry, with producer handlers/milestone-status and a consumer description naming the DONE-phase milestone_status / milestone_closeout frozen-snapshot read path (snapshot-only; never re-blocks DONE).

happy.desc: With the new artifact:milestone-closeout.json registry entry present, npm run test:process-fact-contract passes

edge.desc: The registry entry is unsigned artifact kind with a consumerGate and no signed-artifact semantic, satisfying the contract loop kind/signed/consumerGate assertions

adversarial.desc: Bite test: temporarily removing the milestone-closeout registry entry makes npm run test:process-fact-contract fail with artifact-missing assertion, then restore and re-run green (non-vacuous)

verificationEvidence.note: Contract run on commit b7d953361d prints Process fact contract verified with the artifact:milestone-closeout.json registry entry present.

The requiredArtifactFacts loop mechanically asserts kind=artifact for signed:false, artifact semantic, path match, and consumerGate presence for this entry; the verified run executed those assertions against the new entry. tsc build also passed, proving the semantics array type-checks as ProcessFactSemantic[].

verificationEvidence.command: python3 remove-entry && npm run test:process-fact-contract && git restore && npm run test:process-fact-contract
verificationEvidence.note: Bite test transcript: with the artifact:milestone-closeout.json fact entry removed from PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY the script fails with artifact missing from PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY: artifact=artifact:milestone-closeout.json; after git restore the run prints Process fact contract verified. Source byte-restored (git status clean for the two source files).

items.title: Add milestone-closeout.json to requiredArtifactFacts in verify-process-fact-contract.mjs
items.context: Insert { name: 'artifact:milestone-closeout.json', path: 'milestone-closeout.json', signed: false } into requiredArtifactFacts (scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs ~line 171, next to the milestone-ledger.json line ~196), matching the neighboring assertion pattern. npm run test:process-fact-contract must pass with the registry entry present and fail if the CHK-001 registry entry is removed (non-vacuous check).

happy.desc: requiredArtifactFacts contains { name: artifact:milestone-closeout.json, path: milestone-closeout.json, signed: false } and the contract run stays green

edge.desc: The entry sits in requiredArtifactFacts so the loop also enforces path match and kind (artifact vs signed-artifact) drift for this artifact

adversarial.desc: With the required-list line present but the registry entry absent, the script fails with artifact missing from PROCESS_FACT_REGISTRY (the line is load-bearing, shared bite test with CHK-001)

verificationEvidence.note: requiredArtifactFacts now contains { name: artifact:milestone-closeout.json, path: milestone-closeout.json, signed: false } next to the milestone-ledger line and the contract run stays green.

Because the entry sits in requiredArtifactFacts, the loop enforces path match and kind drift (artifact vs signed-artifact) for this artifact on every contract run; assertions executed in the verified run.

verificationEvidence.command: python3 remove-entry && npm run test:process-fact-contract && git restore && npm run test:process-fact-contract
verificationEvidence.note: Shared bite test with CHK-001: required-list line present but registry entry absent makes the script fail with the artifact-missing assertion, proving the CHK-002 line is load-bearing; restored run green.
